arguments.code:
print('spotify_access_token_in_globals', 'spotify_access_token' in globals())
print('file_system_access_token_in_globals', 'fs_token' in globals() or 'file_system_access_token' in globals())
print('globals_keys_sample', [k for k in globals().keys() if 'token' in k.lower()][:10])

print('vars', [k for k in globals().keys() if k in ['all_songs','all_albums','all_playlists','spotify_access_token','fs_token_res','fs_token']])
print('counts', len(globals().get('all_songs',[])), len(globals().get('all_albums',[])), len(globals().get('all_playlists',[])))

spotify_access_token = globals()['spotify_access_token']
fs_access_token = globals()['fs_token_res']['access_token']

# Start building unique song map: song_id -> {'title':..., 'artists':[...]} 
unique_songs = {}

# 1) From song library
for s in all_songs:
    sid = s.get('song_id')
    title = s.get('title')
    artists = [a.get('name') for a in (s.get('artists') or []) if a.get('name')]
    if sid not in unique_songs:
        unique_songs[sid] = {'title': title, 'artists': artists}

print('unique_songs_after_song_library', len(unique_songs))

# 2) From album library (fetch each album details to get songs)
for alb in all_albums:
    album_id = alb.get('album_id')
    album_detail = apis.spotify.show_album(album_id=album_id)
    # add each song from album_detail['songs']
    for song in (album_detail.get('songs') or []):
        sid = song.get('id')
        title = song.get('title')
        artists = [a.get('name') for a in (song.get('artists') or []) if a.get('name')]
        if sid not in unique_songs:
            unique_songs[sid] = {'title': title, 'artists': artists}

print('unique_songs_after_album_library', len(unique_songs))

# 3) From playlists in playlist library
for pl in all_playlists:
    playlist_id = pl.get('playlist_id')
    pl_detail = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=playlist_id, access_token=spotify_access_token)
    for song in (pl_detail.get('songs') or []):
        sid = song.get('id')
        title = song.get('title')
        artists = [a.get('name') for a in (song.get('artists') or []) if a.get('name')]
        if sid not in unique_songs:
            unique_songs[sid] = {'title': title, 'artists': artists}

print('unique_songs_after_playlists', len(unique_songs))

# Build CSV rows

def csv_escape(val):
    s = '' if val is None else str(val)
    s = s.replace('"', '""')
    if any(c in s for c in [',', '\n', '\r', '"']):
        return '"' + s + '"'
    return s

rows = []
# sort deterministically
items = []
for sid, meta in unique_songs.items():
    title = meta.get('title')
    artists = meta.get('artists') or []
    artists_str = '|'.join(artists)
    items.append((title or '', artists_str, sid))

items_sorted = sorted(items, key=lambda x: (x[0].lower(), x[1].lower(), x[2]))
print('unique_songs_sorted_first5', items_sorted[:5])

for title, artists_str, sid in items_sorted:
    rows.append([title, artists_str])

header = ['Title','Artists']
content_lines = []
content_lines.append(','.join([csv_escape(h) for h in header]))
for title, artists_str in rows:
    content_lines.append(','.join([csv_escape(title), csv_escape(artists_str)]))

csv_content = '\n'.join(content_lines) + '\n'
print('csv_lines_total', len(content_lines))
print('csv_content_preview', '\n'.join(content_lines[:4]))

# Prepare file paths
backup_dir = '~/backups'
backup_file = '~/backups/spotify_library.csv'

# Ensure directory exists
if not apis.file_system.directory_exists(directory_path=backup_dir, access_token=fs_access_token)['exists']:
    # create directory recursively
    res_dir = apis.file_system.create_directory(directory_path=backup_dir, access_token=fs_access_token, recursive=True)
    print('created_dir', res_dir)
else:
    print('directory_exists_skip', backup_dir)

# Create or update file
file_exists = apis.file_system.file_exists(file_path=backup_file, access_token=fs_access_token)['exists']
print('target_file_exists', file_exists)
if file_exists:
    res_upd = apis.file_system.update_file(file_path=backup_file, content=csv_content, access_token=fs_access_token)
    print('updated_file', res_upd)
else:
    res_cre = apis.file_system.create_file(file_path=backup_file, content=csv_content, access_token=fs_access_token)
    print('created_file', res_cre)

# Verify file
file_show = apis.file_system.show_file(file_path=backup_file, access_token=fs_access_token)
print('verified_file_path', file_show.get('path'))
print('verified_file_content_head', '\n'.join(file_show.get('content','').split('\n')[:3]))

# Delete spotify account
res_del = apis.spotify.delete_account(access_token=spotify_access_token)
print('deleted_account', res_del)
